rationale: 2014 crossover in ten trained men, nine with exercise data, combined aqueous Russian tarragon extract or placebo with creatine in both arms; sprint peak power, mean power and total work interactions p=.92, .27 and .27. These are performance tests rather than clinical fatigue after dried culinary leaves.
access_or_open: Primary PMC3975968 Methods and Table 3 available locally; fresh/dried whole-leaf Parkinson fatigue comparison remains open.

rationale: Among 126 adults 31.0% identified dried marjoram odor; stimulus recognition is not a treatment effect on olfactory impairment after eating marjoram.
access_or_open: 2016 institutional primary manuscript and supplementary table accessible; ingestion-specific Parkinson smell outcome open.

rationale: Both diet menus in a Parkinson randomized trial list cooked thyme of unspecified freshness. The more favorable composite Part I result cannot isolate thyme or the apathy item.
access_or_open: Primary report and matched meal plans checked. Ingredient use and item-level apathy outcomes remain open.

rationale: 2016 randomized 24-person trial reports within-tarragon systolic pressure 120.0 to 113.0 mmHg over 90 days; abstract lacks controlled change and standing symptoms, and uses a Russian tarragon supplement rather than fresh leaf.
access_or_open: Registry endpoint means are research/2020-2024/Food-Experiment-Tarragon-Motor-and-Face.md#posted-blood-pressure-values-for-the-tarragon-capsule-trial; original seated/standing dizziness item and between-arm change open.

rationale: Same 2021 marjoram infusion Parkinson trial reports motor and nonmotor totals but no identified dystonia episode or severity measure; no effect of fresh leaves can be isolated.
access_or_open: Individual motor item and dystonia endpoint not shown in accessible report; avoid duplicate count of 2025 biomarker trial.

rationale: Coriander seed-oil mouthrinse study measured salivary microbiome rather than flow or drooling; it is a rinse, not eaten dried leaf.
access_or_open: Known Parkinson diet lists coriander without plant part or confirmed consumption and no separate drooling outcome.

rationale: Mixed Parkinson vegetarian intervention lists chervil as seasoning but gives no individual intake, dried form, or herb-specific fatigue outcome; UPDRS III total does not measure fatigue.
access_or_open: Local primary PMC7072275 and appendix; exact Anthriscus cerefolium dried-leaf fatigue comparison open.

rationale: The shiso rice trial measured odor pleasantness in healthy participants. In mice, induced anosmia blocked the forced-swim effect of inhaled isolated perillaldehyde. The inhibition of this behavioral response does not measure restoration of smell or an oral dried-shiso effect.
access_or_open: Trial jRCT1060240004 excluded post-COVID olfactory dysfunction; no post-ingestion recovery comparison.

rationale: A Parkinson case combined an oral multiherb formula containing Japanese pepper with intravenous levodopa for fecal impaction; neither ground Sichuan pepper nor dyskinesia was independently assessed.
access_or_open: Seek verified Zanthoxylum bungeanum exposure and levodopa-induced abnormal involuntary movements; Japanese pepper and usual locomotion are distinct.

rationale: Russian monograph reports intragastric alcoholic tarragon tinctures changed rat exploratory and search scores and describes sedation, without spontaneous sleep or insomnia measurement; dose form and species population differ from fresh culinary leaf Parkinson claim.
access_or_open: Table 30 and prior 2005/2006 reports have uncertain cohort overlap; original timed induced-sleep chapter remains open.

rationale: Mixed caraway-containing meal provoked oral and respiratory allergy symptoms; seed grinding, culprit attribution and swallowing function are unverified.
access_or_open: Original case assessment and diagnostic provenance remain distinct from a controlled dysphagia outcome.

rationale: 2021 Parkinson randomized pilot used strained dried-leaf tea, with inconclusive motor UPDRS III total change p=.069; no separate facial-expression item or fresh leaf administration is available.
access_or_open: Primary abstract and publisher preview accessible; individual Part III item results and 2025 pilot symptom tables unverified.

rationale: Spearmint-flavored gum increased collected saliva during chewing in healthy volunteers. The two possibly overlapping reports disagree on peak timing. Faster swallowing during gum chewing in Parkinson is a separate pathway. Neither the gum studies nor the Sjögren spray registration measures drooling after eating dried spearmint.
access_or_open: Primary PMID7503931 abstract and catalog note; NCT06313905 tests multi-ingredient spearmint-oil spray for Sjogren saliva without posted results; individual Parkinson drooling measurement open.

rationale: The Parkinson freezers/non-freezers study used clove as a smell-identification item; clove item comparison p=.212, without clove ingestion or intervention on gait freezing.
access_or_open: No effect of eaten ground clove is identified; odor test is not a food assignment.

rationale: Summer savory essential oil in lead-exposed rats measured rotarod balance rather than dystonia; oil differs from fresh culinary leaves.
access_or_open: Seek actual Satureja hortensis leaf and clinically measured dystonia; do not substitute related winter savory.

rationale: Inhaled sweet marjoram oil lowered resting pressure against air in nine healthy people. A later crossover in nurses did not confirm a comparable between-group effect. Standing lightheadedness after fresh-leaf ingestion in Parkinson remains unmeasured.
access_or_open: Full primary PMC10690939; oral marjoram standing-pressure and symptom-controlled trial open.

rationale: The severe-allergy citation identifies allspice. Clinical swallowing observations and ground preparation remain unverified. The inherited other-allspice dictionary match names a different plant.
access_or_open: PMID35577235 primary body remains access-limited; clinical allergy and target chronic Parkinson swallowing must be distinguished.

rationale: Survey names anise in a mixed honey preparation and a separate broad sleep-disturbance category, without verified intake or dream-enactment frequency.
access_or_open: Anise scent in 2026 RBD diagnosis is an odor test and not Pimpinella anisum consumption or dream-frequency change.

rationale: Basil appears in mixed Parkinson menus without confirmed dried intake or a food-specific apathy estimate. Inhaled basil oil reduced forced-swim immobility in stressed mice. This task did not measure clinical apathy.
access_or_open: Primary menu and animal results checked, including the 2021 affiliation correction. Dried basil and individual clinical apathy exposure or outcomes remain open.

rationale: Tarragon scent was one of many odors in a rotating mouse enrichment regimen; endpoint discrimination of two esters improved within enriched knockouts, but there was no isolated tarragon arm or consumption.
access_or_open: Full 2017 primary PMC5288360; human dried tarragon ingestion and smell severity comparison open.

rationale: Whole macadamia kernels caused weakness with occasional stiffness in dogs. Rat oil exposure was studied for chemically induced tissue injury and cerebellar markers. No cold-pressed oil or Parkinson rigidity comparison is established.
access_or_open: Salama author abstract accessible. Journal table access and behavioral reporting remain open. Check an identified oral oil and clinical or model rigidity endpoint.

rationale: Acute excessive nutmeg ingestion preceded upper-limb tremor in a case report. A poison-center case also had multiple co-ingestants. Rest status, ordinary culinary exposure and Parkinson tremor effects remain unresolved.
access_or_open: Illinois series has one tremor case with multiple co-ingestants; no causal attribution or rest-tremor comparison.

rationale: Canola oil is a comparator in a healthy older-adult ketone-ester pilot and a menu constituent in the Parkinson diet trial. The 2024 conference study that measured freezing is a separate anxiety and sleep protocol. Existing gait comparators did not count freezing events.
access_or_open: Complete original conference issue and relevant pages checked. Canola oil grade and freezing-frequency outcomes were not given for the comparison diet.

rationale: research/2020-2024/Food-Experiment-Mustard-Seed-Caraway.md#mustard-on-a-parkinson-diet-menu-and-postural-stability
access_or_open: Participant-specific mustard intake and isolated postural-stability change remain open.
